description: List the Valet organizations the account belongs to, sorted by name, with the one every tool uses when you omit org_name marked as the default. Each organization lists its members (email, name, and when they joined) and its pending invitations (email, when sent, and when they expire). Pass org_name to list one organization. Use the names here as org_name on the other tools. Invitation codes are never shown. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: List only this Valet organization. Omit to list every organization the account belongs to.

name: list_orgs
title: List organizations
